title: Muaat supernova tile on the map
description: The Muaat hero (Adjudicator Ba'al, Nova Seed) replaces a non-home system with the Muaat supernova tile. Before the fix the client kept drawing the setup tiles, so the tile never changed and the units that moved in sat on a system id (81) with no tile. The board view now applies the recorded tile edits. The board JSON is projected by the real engine/host code (cargo example nova_seed_board) from a real 6-player game before and after the edit; the page is the real app on a mocked transport.

shots.heading: Before the hero (desktop)
shots.caption: A non-home system with planets holds a Muaat war sun, a cruiser and a destroyer, and another player's cruiser.

shots.heading: After Nova Seed (desktop)
shots.caption: The same hex is the supernova tile; the Muaat fleet is on it, the other player's cruiser is gone, the planets are gone.

notes.title: Reproduce
notes.text: cargo run -p ti4-host --example nova_seed_board -- web/e2e/screenshots/GK-nova-seed-tile/data, then cd web && npm run screenshots -- GK.

notes.title: Not shown
notes.text: The hero's prompt in a played game and the production step after it are covered by engine tests (rules version 21).
